# Chat Downloader (Download Claude conversations)
> Free Chrome extension to download Claude.ai chats as PDF, Markdown, Plain Text, JSON, XML, CSV, or PNG — unlimited with no account, except PDF and bulk ZIP (3 a day free with Google sign-in). Also called Claude Chat Downloader and Claude Conversation Downloader.

- Home: https://chat-downloader.com/

- Download Claude conversation: https://chat-downloader.com/download-claude-conversation/
- How to save a Claude conversation: https://chat-downloader.com/how-to-save-claude-conversation/
- How to export a Claude chat: https://chat-downloader.com/how-to-export-claude-chat/
- Export Claude chat: https://chat-downloader.com/export-claude-chat/

- Download a Claude chat as PDF: https://chat-downloader.com/download-claude-chat-as-pdf/

Facts:
- Current extension version: 1.16.2 (Chrome Web Store, September 2026).
- Claude.ai History already stores signed-in chats. There is no in-product Save button that writes a file.
- Claude.ai has no built-in per-chat download button.
- Official Anthropic export is Settings → Privacy → Export data (account JSON ZIP by email).
- Seven export formats: PDF, Markdown, Plain Text, JSON, XML, CSV, PNG. PDF is built in the browser, with no print dialog.
- Free plan, no account: unlimited single-chat exports in Markdown, Plain Text, JSON, XML, CSV and PNG; unlimited copy to clipboard (Markdown, Plain Text, JSON, XML, CSV); unlimited artifact, project-files and session ZIPs. No Google sign-in, no counter.
- PDF export and bulk ZIP export (Export All on the Dashboard) need Google sign-in and are capped at 3 per day on the free plan, combined. Each chat in a bulk ZIP counts as one. The day resets at midnight UTC.
- Pro: $3.99 a month or $26.99 a year, via Paddle. Unlimited PDF and bulk export. Cancel any time; 14-day money-back guarantee on the first payment.
- Every format is generated locally in the browser; conversation text is not uploaded, stored or analysed. Only after sign-in for PDF, bulk or Pro does the extension send the Google account email for a subscription and quota check.
- Works with regular chats, Projects, Cowork sessions and Claude Code on the web sessions (claude.ai/code) — anything that opens on claude.ai in Chrome.
- Claude Code in the terminal is different: use /export or JSONL under ~/.claude/projects. This Chrome extension does not read local Claude Code terminal sessions.
- Claude Desktop is a separate app; there is no Desktop plugin. To export a Desktop chat, open the same chat on claude.ai in Chrome. No mobile app.
- Independent extension, not affiliated with Anthropic, PBC.
